channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Burhachapori eviction drive continues on Day 2 amid resistance in Sonitpur
item.description: Administration said some encroachers tried to block eviction, allegedly chasing security forces & journalists wielding machetes, sticks

item.title: Assam CM flags rising violence against minorities in Bangladesh, urges caution
item.description: Sarma also flagged Bangladesh-based terror networks, says Assam security concerns will persist until regional situation stabilises

item.title: Assam Book Fair ends with Rs 7.4 Cr sales in 14 days, literary awards conferred
item.description: The 14-day fair concluded with literary-cultural programmes, and presentation of Assam Publication Board Literary Awards 2025

item.title: CCTOA panel rejects ST status proposal for six Assam communities
item.description: The Consultative Group of CCTOA opposed Scheduled Tribe status for six communities, terming the move unconstitutional and historically untenable

item.title: Assam govt weighs Ziaul Kamar, Pallab Kataki as special prosecutor in Zubeen Garg case
item.description: Senior advocate Ziaul Kamar and criminal lawyer Pallab Kataki are among the names under consideration as special public prosecutor in the high profile death case.

item.title: Manipuri community holds massive rally in Silchar for Autonomous Council
item.description: The leaders warned that further delay could lead to intensified agitation.

item.title: Repeated oil pipeline burst sparks fear in Dibrugarh's Tingkhong village
item.description: The repeated leakage has caused extensive damage, with crude oil spreading across agricultural fields and fish-rearing ponds in the area.

item.title: Nagaland Dy CM Y Patton calls for reporting of crimes to strengthen policing
item.description: Inaugurating new SP office building & police barracks at Wokha recently, Patton highlighted the issue of under-reported cases

item.title: MNF quits ZPM alliance, throws Mizoram's Lai ADC politics into fresh uncertainty
item.description: In a letter submitted to Governor Gen (Dr) Vijay Kumar Singh (retd), the MNF conveyed its decision to snap ties with the LLP

item.title: Cold wave grips Assam; schools shut, timings revised across districts
item.description: Primary schools will function from 10 am to 1.30 pm, upper primary schools from 10 am to 2 pm, & secondary & senior secondary schools from 10 am to 2.30 pm in Kamrup (M)
